tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the treatments offered by the practice with duration, price and whether they run online, plus opening hours and the daily appointment times.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.title: List session bundles
tools.description: List the multi-session bundles the practice offers, with the number of sessions, total price, per-session price and how long each bundle stays valid.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.title: Check availability
tools.description: Which appointment times are still free on a given date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns only free/taken times — never any client details.

tools.name: practice_info
tools.title: Practice information
tools.description: Where the practice is, how to reach it, when it is open, and answers to the questions clients ask most often.
